title: Workers finish within their turn cap and their brief: commit before the cap, a cap that fits, siblings' docs, no shared stash
goal: A worker near its turn cap commits its work in progress on work/<id> and reports what is left, and dispatch's cap fits a task that adds a module, tests and docs or a story that only writes a report; the goal line of a worker's brief names the cap dispatch gives, not a fixed 60 turns; the brief's sibling list lets a worker edit a kb/_self doc its sibling also touches; the baseline route the role file and brief name uses commands a worker's permissions allow and never the shared git stash; kb-sprint run starts backlog.py dispatch in the background with a long timeout, and its review parks a gap with no repro command as a draft story or a bug with --repro-reason

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?

notes: Run order 17 of 19 from the 2026-10-12 draft triage: lookup correctness and benchmark measurement first, then kb content, then tooling that fixes recurring sprint failures.
